凌晨六点整，起床号准时响起。

“嘀嘀嗒嗒嘀嘀——”

王建新立马从床上弹起来，穿衣服。动作快，有条不紊，先穿衬衣，再套裤子，扣子从上往下扣，鞋带系紧。今天是正式上课第一天，六点起床，六点半出操，七点整理内务，七点半早餐，八点就正式上课了。

宿舍里一阵窸窸窣窣。刘卫东从上铺跳下来，一边穿鞋一边嘟囔：“这跟部队没啥区别嘛，还以为上大学能睡个懒觉呢。”

“想得美。”林大山已经从铺上坐起来，动作又快又麻利，“你在部队怎么过，在这还怎么过。”

王建新已经穿好了四个兜的干部服，正在系扣子。郭大江收拾利索后，看了一眼手表，说：“操场上已经开始集合了，快走吧。”

六个人匆匆下楼，汇入了操场上的队伍。

九月初的北京，早晨有点凉。操场上笼罩着一层薄薄的雾气，各系的学员陆陆续续从宿舍楼出来，朝操场走去。穿军装的、穿便装的，汇成几道人流。

当王建新他们赶到操场时，陆陆续续人们还在出来。但不到六点半，他们队的所有学员已经整齐地站好了队列——现役军人学员动作快，来得早，站得整整齐齐。穿便装的学员慢一些，有的从宿舍跑出来，一边跑一边扣扣子。

王建新扫了一眼，有些便装学员手忙脚乱，有人扣子都扣错了位，衣领一高一低；有人鞋带没系，跑两步鞋就掉了，蹲下来重新系。

王建新迅速整理队列。

“立正——！向右看——齐！向前——看！”

口令干脆利落，声音洪亮。学员们刷刷刷地移动脚步，排成了整齐的方队。

王建新站在队列前面，目光从左扫到右。现役军人学员穿着军装，腰板挺直。

“稍息！”王建新喊了一声，然后转身跑到刘教导员面前，立正敬礼，“教导员，学员队集合完毕，应到三十四人，实到三十四人。请指示！”

刘教导员回礼：“带队出操。”

“是！”

王建新跑回队列前面，喊道：“全体都有——立正！向左转——！跑步——走！”

At six o'clock in the morning, the wake-up call sounded on time.

"Tick-tick-tick-tick-"

Wang Jianxin immediately jumped out of bed and got dressed.Move quickly and methodically, put on the shirt first, then put on the pants, button from top to bottom, and tie the shoelaces tightly.Today is the first official day of class. I get up at six o'clock, do exercises at six thirty, clean up the housework at seven o'clock, have breakfast at seven thirty, and officially start class at eight o'clock.

There was a rustling in the dormitory.Liu Weidong jumped down from the upper bunk and muttered while putting on his shoes: "This is no different from the army. I thought I could sleep in in college."

"What a beautiful idea." Lin Dashan had already sat up from the bunk, moving quickly and deftly, "How can you survive in the army, how can you survive here."

Wang Jianxin has already put on the four-pocket cadre uniform and is buttoning it.After Guo Dajiang tidied up, he glanced at his watch and said, "The gathering has started on the playground. Let's go quickly."

The six people hurried downstairs and joined the team on the playground.

In Beijing in early September, the morning was a bit cool.A thin layer of mist enveloped the playground. Students from various departments came out of the dormitory building one after another and walked towards the playground.People in military uniforms and people in casual clothes formed several streams of people.

When Wang Jianxin and others rushed to the playground, people were still coming out one after another.But before six-thirty, all the students in their team were already standing in line neatly - the active-duty military students moved quickly, came early, and stood neatly.The students in casual clothes were slower, and some ran out of the dormitory, buttoning their buttons as they ran.

Wang Jianxin took a glance and saw that some students in plain clothes were in a hurry. Some had buttoned their buttons in the wrong place, and their collars were high and one low. Some had untied shoelaces, and their shoes fell off after running two steps. They had to squat down and tie them again.

Wang Jianxin quickly organized the queue.

"Stand at attention——! Look to the right——Qi! Look forward——!"

The password is crisp and clear, and the voice is loud.The students moved quickly and formed a neat square formation.

Wang Jianxin stood in front of the queue, looking from left to right.Active-duty military cadets wear military uniforms with their backs straight.

"Take a break!" Wang Jianxin shouted, then turned and ran to Instructor Liu, stood at attention and saluted, "Instructor, the student team has been assembled. There should be thirty-four people, but there are actually thirty-four. Please give instructions!"

Instructor Liu responded: "Lead the team for exercise."

"Yes!"

Wang Jianxin ran back to the front of the queue and shouted: "Everyone - stand at attention! Turn left -! Run - walk!"
